name: Mothers Against Daughters
overview: Scripture reveals the profound divisions that the gospel can bring within families, including between mothers and daughters, as Jesus foretold that His coming would ignite conflict even among the closest relationships. Luke 12 describes this division as a consequence of the kingdom's advance, where allegiance to Christ may set family members against one another. Paul’s warning in Philippians highlights that some oppose the cross of Christ, underscoring the spiritual battles that can fracture familial bonds when faith is at stake.
